newsitem.title: USA: Vencor says 99.8 pct of notes repurchased.
newsitem.headline: Vencor says 99.8 pct of notes repurchased.

text.p: Vencor Inc said Thursday about 99.8 percent of the principal of the eight percent outstanding subordinated notes of its wholly owned subsidiary TheraTx Inc have been tendered for repurchase.
The company said the tendered notes will be repurchased on May 12.
The company said the notes are tendered for repurchase according to the repurchase rights each holder was entitled to under the terms of their formal agreement. The convertible notes are due 2002.
The company said the foregoing right to require that TheraTx buyback the notes expired Wednesday.
The company also said it has amended the agreement governing the outstanding notes.
The company said TheraTx no longer has to to give over certain reports, including annual and quarterly financial statements, to holders of notes. Vencor will instead give over those reports.
